label: Konto, Anmeldung & Standalone-Seiten
navNotes: Pages outside the App shell (no sidebar/top bar). Most use a centred column ('mx-auto max-w-md'); /login uses the marketing site look (SiteShell, .field/.pill classes); /print and /site-preview are full-page renderers.

pages.title: Bei roots anmelden
pages.purpose: Sign in with password, create an account, get a magic link, or sign in with a passkey.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Passwort
fields.notes: 'Passwort vergessen?' link next to the label

sections.title: Painting
sections.notes: Right half on lg only: artwork with credit line. LocaleSwitcher under the form; 'roots' wordmark → /.

actions.label: Konto erstellen
actions.result: session → next, else toast 'Wir haben dir einen Link an {email} geschickt. Bestätige damit dein Konto.'

actions.label: Mit Passkey anmelden
actions.target: supabase signInWithPasskey (also offered in email autofill)

uxNotes: Sign-in and sign-up share one form: 'Konto erstellen' uses the same email/password fields with no repeat-password or name field.
Login uses the marketing site's design (SiteShell) while /forgot, /onboarding, /invite, /account use plain App styles – two looks in one flow.
The forgot link drops ?next, so after a reset the user ends in /account, not where they wanted to go.

actions.label: Link senden
actions.result: toast 'Falls es ein Konto für {email} gibt, haben wir einen Link geschickt.' (link lands on /account?reset=1)

pages.title: Dein Konto
pages.purpose: Standalone personal settings (picture, name, language, theme, notification prefs, password) for the reset flow and people without an org.

sections.title: ProfileForms
sections.notes: Same component as /settings/profile (see settings.json) without orgs, passkeys, AI sections. 'Zurück' link → App home.

uxNotes: Duplicate of Settings › Profil with fewer sections; passkeys and AI keys only exist on the in-App version.

pages.title: Organisation anlegen
pages.purpose: First org for a new account (or an additional one via ?new=1 from the org switcher); accept pending invites.
pages.permission: signed in; redirects to App home when already in an org (unless ?new=1)

sections.title: Du wurdest eingeladen
sections.notes: one row per pending invite (org, role) + 'Beitreten'; then 'Oder gründe eine eigene Organisation:'

uxNotes: Slug is not suggested from the name; the user must invent a URL slug before seeing the product.
With ?new=1 there is no way back to the App except the browser back button.

pages.title: {org} beitreten (or 'Einladung ungültig')
pages.purpose: Accept a team invite: join when signed in, otherwise create an account for the invited email (or sign in).

urlState.meaning: email the confirmation link went to → 'Fast geschafft' state

sections.title: Fast geschafft
sections.notes: after sign-up when email confirmation is needed: text + 'Mail erneut senden'

uxNotes: Signed in with a different email than invited: page still offers 'Beitreten' (server decides); no hint about the mismatch up front.

pages.title: {app} mit roots verbinden
pages.purpose: Approve or deny an AI app (MCP client) connecting to roots: choose org and access level.

sections.title: Consent card
sections.notes: Invalid request: oauth.invalid; no allowed org: oauth.noOrg (also when all orgs switched AI off – text says 'lege zuerst eine an').

uxNotes: oauth.noOrg says 'Du bist in keiner Organisation' also when the user has orgs but all have KI-Apps switched off (Settings › API) – misleading.

pages.title: Bestellung · <amount>
pages.purpose: Buyer's landing page after hosted checkout: shows payment status only.

sections.title: Status
sections.notes: org name, title, message: paid / cancelled / failed / expired / open / not found; open → 'Aktualisieren' link

uxNotes: Lives on the App surface in App styles (code note: should move to the org's public site); no link back to the org's site, tickets or order page.
Open state requires manual 'Aktualisieren' (no auto refresh).

pages.title: Vom Verteiler abmelden
pages.purpose: Unsubscribe from campaign/automation emails via a button (not on GET).
uxNotes: No org name/branding shown – the person can't see which sender they unsubscribe from; no undo.

pages.title: Bild hochladen / Dateien hochladen
pages.purpose: Upload link created by an AI app/API key: drop a picture or files that land on the record.

sections.title: Dropper

fields.name: file
fields.label: Bild hierher ziehen oder auswählen / Dateien …
fields.notes: hint 'Bis {mb} MB. Fotos werden automatisch verkleinert.'

sections.notes: Done: 'Fertig. Du kannst zurück zu Claude gehen.'; expired: upload.expired

uxNotes: Copy mentions Claude specifically although any MCP/API client can create the link.

pages.title: <Document title + number> (browser tab)
pages.purpose: Print view of a quote/invoice on A4 with template switch, server PDF and browser print.
uxNotes: No way back to the invoice from the print page (opened outside the App shell); template choice here does not save the org's default.

pages.title: (iframe content)
pages.purpose: Renders the website draft (start page, ?page=event with the next event, ?page=portal with example member 'Erika') for the Website editors' preview iframe.
uxNotes: Calls notFound() when the anonymous public_site RPC returns nothing (cachedSite null); then the editor's preview iframe shows a 404 instead of a hint.
